extras.final_text:
I found one regional marine heatwave event in the region, from 2008-06-01 to 2008-06-21. It is the only event in the 2008-06-01 to 2008-08-31 period.

I followed the method as written. The region has 3,301 sea cells out of 3,600. The baseline pools used 1992–2002 plus the five days of padding at each end.

The event starts on the first day of the period. I restricted the data to the target period before finding runs, as instructed, so I can't tell whether it began earlier in May.

Both output files are written: `output/mhw_mask.nc` and `output/report.json`. I set `complete` to true. The caveat in the report only notes the baseline padding days.

The run printed two warnings, neither of which changed the output. One was a pandas deprecation notice. The other was an "all-NaN slice" warning from the percentile calculation, which I take to come from land cells, since only sea cells are used afterwards. I did not check which cells triggered it.
